attempts: Only github.run_attempt 1. No retry/install/fallback/runtime/main. New ordinary pushes are distinct source-bound runs, never reuse a nonce or old allowance.

snapshot.swift_descendant_count: Unknown before execution. SwiftPM builds the selected test target and dependencies, but selects one snapshot test body.
snapshot.compiler_and_dependency_fetch_scope: Separate producer prerequisite, broader than Java compile-only collection. Existing exact Swift package pins may be fetched in this new CI job. No tool installer, arbitrary dependency update or full Android build.
snapshot.custody_limit: Workflow step exit and logs only for the existing Apple verifier and SwiftPM. This source proposal does not add a new macOS exact-kernel command supervisor or attest escaped descendants/provider disposal.
snapshot.scratch_cleanup: Snapshot source data, command logs and Swift scratch retained in owned RUNNER_TEMP; no local scratch created, no old process or other project accessed. Provider cleanup is not attested.

snapshot_upload_admission.exact_namespace: started.json, snapshot-receipt.json and the exact complete declared consumer/Generated/MixerAndroid tree; no extra empty directories, symlinks or special nodes.

host_log_upload_admission.namespace: Nonempty subset of eight explicitly named source/tool/log files; no directories, symlinks or special nodes.

compile.scratch_cleanup: Unchanged Linux custody helper; all owned evidence/scratch retained on success/failure, unresolved custody permanently stops later children.

identity_gate.artifact_id: positive ASCII decimal, no leading zero, bounded unsigned64 value

wall_budget.enforcement: Monotonic checks in traversal, bounded chunk hashing, file-only tool checks, DEX decoding and JSON writes; reserve60+6+2 before each unchanged custody command; no child in retention.
wall_budget.system_boundary: Cooperative checkpoints do not preempt a blocked provider/kernel/filesystem syscall. Such a stall has no accepted completion guarantee; workflow timeout remains the outer bound.

output_budget.upload_admission: Only steps.collect.outputs.output_artifact_ready==true admits upload after successful final bounded scan. On retention/cap failure, skip whole-directory upload; leave evidence retained on provider and report refusal in bounded workflow stderr.
output_budget.durable_reservation: Original exclusive run/head/attempt/job reservation remains in RUNNER_TEMP. Its exact bounded byte copy is reservation.json inside the capped artifact and both are rehashed before/after each child. Only the capped output root is uploaded.

download_pin_evidence.basis: Read-only connected GitHub git/ref/tags/v4 and immutable action.yml
download_pin_evidence.separate_saved_connector_receipt: Root may attach it; not queried by this lane.
download_pin_evidence.actual_runner_execution_runtime: Pending for this proposal; existing current CI can force Node24 for v4 actions, so declared Node20 is not an execution receipt.

artifact_transfer.archive_digest: Exact artifact ID and declared digest are action metadata bindings only. Download unpacks without retained archive. No independent archive-byte checksum, kernel transport or provider-disposal proof.
artifact_transfer.consumer_source_byte_identities: All exact18 and entire actual generated snapshot manifest checked before/after each tool child.
